:::{#thm-prob-positive}
#### Probability of a positive test

The probability $\Pr(+)$ that a diagnostic test is positive is:

$$
\Pr(+) =
\text{sensitivity} \cd \text{prevalence}
+ \paren{1 - \text{specificity}} \cd \paren{1 - \text{prevalence}}
$$ {#eq-prob-positive}

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-prob-positive.

:::
